name.zh: 青花彩线·纸感叙事拼景
name.en: Cobalt colored-line narrative montage on warm paper

note.zh: 工笔线描式文创叙事插画；不是对真实制作媒介的鉴定。
note.en: Fine-line cultural narrative illustration; this is not an identification of the actual production medium.

note.zh: 蓝白器物和水纹贯穿画面，暖米底与棕色人物形成对照，粉花绿叶点缀。
note.en: Blue-white ceramics and water run throughout, contrasted with cream ground and brown figures, accented by pink flowers and green leaves.

note.zh: 色块内明暗较简化，少见统一方向的强烈投影。
note.en: Shading within shapes is simplified, with little strong directional cast shadow.

note.zh: 蓝色水带曲折串联多个场景，场景之间露出米色底。
note.en: Curved blue water ribbons connect separate scenes with cream ground visible between them.

note.zh: 老人明显大于周围工匠，花朵、器物与建筑不遵守同一真实比例。
note.en: The elder is much larger than surrounding workers; flowers, vessels and buildings do not share a single physical scale.

note.zh: 主角有皱纹和工作手势，小人物更概括，器物轮廓规整。
note.en: The main figure has wrinkles and working gestures, supporting people are simplified, and vessel silhouettes are orderly.

note.zh: 轮廓多为细线，颜色按物体变化，内部有衣褶与装饰线。
note.en: Fine outlines vary by object color, with internal garment and ornamental lines.

note.zh: 边界清楚，蓝白浪花以闭合色块和线条分层。
note.en: Boundaries are clear; blue-white waves are layered through closed color shapes and lines.

note.zh: 重复纹样和结构线整齐，未见主导性的随机涂抹。
note.en: Repeated motifs and structural lines are orderly, without dominant random brush marks.

note.zh: 底色有细微斑驳，人物和器物内部纹样清晰。
note.en: The background is subtly mottled while patterns on clothing and ceramics remain clear.

note.zh: 局部纹样细密，模块之间仍有较大留白。
note.en: Local motifs are intricate while substantial blank spaces remain between clusters.

note.zh: 高对比蓝白圆盘托住主角，外框明显更淡。
note.en: A contrasting blue-white plate supports the main figure, while the outer frame is much paler.

note.zh: 蓝白与米棕冷暖对比、主角与配角大小对比、局部繁密与空隙对比。
note.en: Blue-white versus cream-brown temperature, main versus supporting scale, and dense clusters versus gaps.

references.source: User-provided ceramic craft illustration in this conversation; author and original medium unverified.

instruction.zh: 用细而连续的彩色线条勾勒形体，以少量内部线条表达结构；避免粗黑描边、摄影渲染和厚重笔触。
instruction.en: Draw forms with fine continuous colored outlines and restrained internal structural lines; avoid thick black outlines, photographic rendering and heavy brushwork.
